evidence_quotes.quote: Physical dimensions 57.8 x 85.1 x 19.6 mm; Weight 84.8 g; Display 2.6 inch (246 x 322 pixels) touchscreen + physical buttons; IPX7
Battery life: up to 32 hours in demanding use with solar charging (up to 60 hours in battery saver mode); 32 GB internal memory; Multi-band GNSS
Native Shimano Di2 and SRAM AXS electronic shifting integration displaying gear ratios, battery status, and hood button mapping
